title: Shoe Wash Bag with Zipper – Blue, for Sneakers
descriptionHtml:
Wash sneakers safely in the machine

Shoes that rattle around loose in the washing machine wear on both the shoes and the machine. The noise is loud and the result is rarely good.

A bag that keeps the shoes in place

This shoe wash bag has a zipper that keeps the shoes still throughout the wash. It fits both the washing machine and the dryer and is reusable.

Features

  • Zipper that keeps the shoes in place
  • Fits washing machine and dryer
  • Protects both shoes and machine
  • Fits most types of shoes
  • Reusable and durable

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
